pages.text: The tourist track is a relaxing path focused on management simulation. Once you build your first tourist-interactive building, tourists arrive the next day.
Tourist Track Goals:$(br2)Satisfy tourists → Upgrade town level$(br2)Deploy shops and ATMs wisely → Earn elements from visitors
Build hotels and resting facilities → Keep tourists from leaving due to exhaustion or lack of lodging.$(br2)Recommended reading order:
